item.title: ‘I have no children’: My aunt gave me $50,000 for a down payment. Now she wants me to leave my home to her two children.
item.description: “The house cost $385,000. With my savings, her $50,000 and a small mortgage, I was able to close.”
item.dc:creator: Quentin Fottrell

item.title: ‘I feel like a loser’: My stock portfolio is swinging wildly. Is it finally time to worry?
item.description: “I presume these are sophisticated investors taking a profit.”
item.dc:creator: Quentin Fottrell

item.title: My brother-in-law convinced his parents to sign over their home and life savings to buy a $3 million compound. Do I intervene?
item.description: “Both properties will be solely in his name.”
item.dc:creator: Quentin Fottrell

item.title: I’m a 68-year-old widow and give money to my two adult children. Am I putting my retirement at risk?
item.description: “I also have $310,000 in an IRA and $46,000 in savings. My house is paid off.”
item.dc:creator: Quentin Fottrell
